intro: Before starting the course, look honestly at where you stand. For each dimension, choose the number that best matches your real situation today: 1 = very weak or absent, 2 = weak, 3 = average, 4 = good, 5 = excellent or solid. Be honest: this sheet is a personal mirror, not a contest or a judgment.

dimensions.desc: My relationship with God is alive, nourished, concrete in daily life.
I master my thoughts and emotions — I am not tossed about by them.
I take care of my health, my hygiene, my physical well-being.
My basic needs are covered — housing, food, clothing.
I keep learning, reading, training myself in modern tools.
I carry out a stable activity — professional, entrepreneurial or ministerial.
I manage my resources wisely — savings, giving, controlled spending.
I have a positive impact on those around me. I contribute to my community.

questions: What do you see on this sheet that you had not yet clearly named?
Which module of the Course do you need the most — and why?
What is the ONE concrete thing you commit to changing in the next 30 days?
engagement: I acknowledge where I am. I do not condemn myself. I choose to move forward.
